metadata.scope: Current SPA UI (src/App.tsx, src/components/*) reviewed from source; WCAG AA; judged for Kenyan mobile buyers ordering via WhatsApp / M-Pesa
metadata.method: Static code review + color_contrast_checker.py + jsdom render check of ProductDetailModal

findings.description: On a 360px phone the first product sits below the header, vehicle bar, Step-1 card, the full promo poster and 5 rows of category tiles (9 tiles in a 2-column grid) plus the search box — roughly three screens of scrolling before any part is visible
findings.fix: On mobile: collapse categories into one horizontally scrolling chip row, shrink the promo to a single-line banner, and put search + first results above the fold

findings.description: Every product row carries three competing actions (WhatsApp, Add to Order, details chevron) plus side chips; on mobile the WhatsApp button is icon-only while Add to Order is labelled, so the channel most buyers use looks secondary
findings.fix: Decide the primary action per context (WhatsApp for most buyers) and keep one labelled primary + one secondary per row

findings.description: Core information is set at 9-11px (text-[9px]/[10px]/[11px]) and 12px (text-xs): stock badges, fitment badges, side labels, unit prices, form labels, promo sublabels. Too small for outdoor phone use and for older mechanics
findings.fix: Minimum 12px for any label, 14px for body and form inputs, 16px for inputs to avoid iOS zoom; reserve 11px for non-essential metadata only

findings.description: Barlow Condensed (the brand display face) appears only in the promo poster; everything else is Plus Jakarta Sans with many uppercase tracking-wider micro-labels, so the brand voice is inconsistent
findings.fix: Use font-display for section headings and prices; cut the uppercase micro-label pattern down to one or two places

findings.description: WhatsApp buttons use white on emerald-600 (#059669) at 3.77:1 — fails AA for their 12-14px bold text. These are the most-used buttons on the site
findings.fix: Use emerald-700 (#047857, 5.48:1) or #05875F for WhatsApp button backgrounds

findings.description: slate-400 (#94A3B8) is used for real content — 'Side:' label, category counts, 'Clear', 'Filtering by', placeholders — at 2.45-2.56:1
findings.fix: Replace with slate-500 (#64748B, 4.76:1) or darker for anything the user must read

findings.description: M-Pesa green (#0F8A5F) button with white text is 4.36:1 — just under AA
findings.fix: Darken to #0C7450 (the existing hover color)

findings.description: Green is overloaded: it means WhatsApp, 'fits your car', 'only show my car' toggle, M-Pesa and 'Free'. A buyer can't tell a fitment confirmation from a WhatsApp button at a glance
findings.fix: Reserve green for fitment/success; give WhatsApp its own treatment (icon + label) and keep M-Pesa green only inside the payment step

findings.description: 9 category tiles in an 8-column desktop grid leaves one orphan tile on a second row
findings.fix: Use 9 columns, a scroll row, or merge two categories

findings.description: Header content is max-w-6xl while ActiveVehicleBar is max-w-5xl, so the vehicle chip doesn't align with the logo and results on desktop
findings.fix: Use one container width token

findings.description: The M-Pesa checkout is a simulation that asks the customer to type their M-Pesa PIN into the web page, shows Paybill 247247 (not Nexo's) and generates a fake receipt, then marks the order 'PAID'. If deployed, customers will believe they paid, and it trains them to enter their PIN on websites — the exact pattern M-Pesa fraud uses
findings.fix: Remove the PIN field and fake receipt before any public launch. Until Daraja STK push is integrated server-side, route 'Pay' to WhatsApp confirmation or 'Reserve & pay at counter' and show the real till/paybill

findings.description: Order tracking never changes: status is stored in localStorage when the order is placed and nothing updates it, so 'Track Order' shows the same step forever
findings.fix: Hide tracking until there is a backend, or replace it with 'We'll confirm on WhatsApp' plus the order reference

findings.description: Every Add to Order opens the checkout drawer, interrupting buyers who need several parts (e.g. both tail lenses + fog lamps)
findings.fix: Show a non-blocking toast with 'View order' and a persistent cart count; open the drawer only on explicit tap

findings.description: No out-of-stock state: a product with inStock 0 would still show 'Only 0 left' and remain addable
findings.fix: Disable Add to Order at 0, switch the CTA to 'Ask on WhatsApp for next shipment'

findings.description: Share copies window.location.href, which is always the homepage because products have no URLs
findings.fix: Add product URLs (see auto-seo-schema) and share those

findings.description: Search can't handle how Kenyans actually ask: 'Harrier 2015' (the vehicle modal's own placeholder example) returns nothing, multi-word queries like 'premio tail' return nothing, and a chassis number copied from a logbook ('NZT260-3021488') matches nothing — search is a single substring match
findings.fix: Tokenise queries; match each word against title, model, chassis codes, part number; parse 4-digit years against yearMin/yearMax; strip the serial after '-' in chassis numbers

findings.description: Below 768px the header hides 'Can't Find Part?', the phone number and 'Track Order'. Mobile is the main audience and calling the counter is a key action
findings.fix: Add a mobile sticky bottom bar: Call · WhatsApp · My car · Order

findings.description: No routing: the phone back button leaves the site instead of closing a modal or going back to results, and filters/search/product can't be linked or shared on WhatsApp
findings.fix: Add a router with /cars/..., /p/... and push history for modals

findings.description: viewport meta sets maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no — buyers can't pinch-zoom product photos to compare lens shapes or read small text
findings.fix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 only

findings.description: Touch targets below 44px: side chips (~26px), checkout quantity -/+ (~20px), trash icon, modal close buttons (32px), clear-vehicle X (~22px), filter-chip X (12px icon)
findings.fix: min-h-11 min-w-11 on all tappable controls

findings.description: Positive: bottom-sheet modals, sticky purchase bar in product detail, 48px primary pay button — the mobile intent is right
findings.fix: Keep; extend the same pattern to the catalog

findings.description: Modals/drawers have no Escape handling, no focus trap and don't return focus; dialogs lack aria-labelledby
findings.fix: Use a dialog primitive (native <dialog> or Radix Dialog) for all four overlays

findings.description: Clickable non-buttons: product photo <div> and title <h3> have onClick but aren't focusable
findings.fix: Wrap in a <button> or link to the product URL

findings.description: Icon-only buttons without accessible names: checkout close, can't-find close, quantity -/+ in checkout, trash (title only), mobile WhatsApp (title only), filter-chip X buttons
findings.fix: Add aria-label to each

findings.description: Form labels aren't associated with inputs (no htmlFor/id); search inputs have no label; validation errors aren't announced (no role=alert / aria-invalid)
findings.fix: Associate labels, add aria-describedby for errors and role=alert on the error box

findings.description: focus:outline-none on inputs and the logo button with only a subtle border change as replacement
findings.fix: Global focus-visible ring (2px nexo-red, offset 2px)

findings.description: Side/fitment selection state conveyed only by color (dark vs light chip) with no aria-pressed
findings.fix: aria-pressed on toggle chips, or use a radio group

findings.description: animate-in / fade-in classes are used on every overlay but no animation plugin is installed, so they do nothing
findings.fix: Add tw-animate-css or remove the classes; the project already ships `motion`

findings.description: Pulsing red dot in the vehicle bar animates forever with no prefers-reduced-motion handling
findings.fix: motion-safe:animate-pulse

findings.description: Product detail specs are hard-coded for every product: 'Material: UV-Treated Polycarbonate', 'Condition: Brand New / OEM Spec', 'Origin: Direct Factory Import' — shown on jumper cables, floor mats and bottle jacks too
findings.fix: Drive specs from product data and omit rows that don't apply

findings.description: Fitment data errors: '3-Step Chrome Grille – Hiace 200' is marked UNIVERSAL, so it shows 'Fits your Premio/Harrier'; UNIVERSAL is treated as 'fits every car' everywhere
findings.fix: Set the grille to BOTH/PAIR with fitVehicles only; show universal items as 'Universal' rather than 'Fits your X'

findings.description: When a part does NOT fit, the detail panel still says 'Counter verified: Guaranteed direct replacement match'
findings.fix: Show that line only when isExactFit is true

findings.description: Unbacked promises: '100% Fitment Guarantee', 'respond in 2 minutes', 'Ready in 15 mins', 'Instant dispatch to any mechanic garage in Kenya', 'thousands of parts', 'VAT incl.' — none linked to a policy
findings.fix: Keep only what the shop commits to in writing; link the footer's 'test-fit and exchange' promise to a policy page

findings.description: Internal/jargon labels shown to customers: 'ERP Item Code', 'Order Tray', 'Showing N parts in stock' (counts results, not stock)
findings.fix: Show part number only; use 'Cart' or 'My order'; 'N parts'

findings.description: Positive: genuinely local copy — Boda rider, 2NK/Easy Coach parcels, 'Mechanic name', 'Shell Globe', LH passenger / RH driver (correct for Kenyan RHD cars), chassis-number quote flow
findings.fix: Keep this voice

findings.description: Promo poster uses the stock AI treatment: blurred glowing orbs, 4-up icon+title+subtitle feature grid ('Clear Vision / Durable / Perfect Fit / OEM Style'), gradient overlay on photo
findings.fix: Replace with the actual WhatsApp poster style the shop uses: bold product photo, price, part number, car — no orbs

findings.description: Sparkles icon used for 'Tail Lenses', 'Chrome Kits' and 'Featured'; Eye icon for head lenses — generic icon picks rather than part silhouettes
findings.fix: Use simple part silhouettes (lens, lamp, mat, visor) or photos

findings.description: Generated product photos (filenames with timestamps) instead of real counter stock; buyers of lenses compare exact shapes
findings.fix: Photograph real stock, both sides, with part number visible

findings.description: Images are 550-850 KB JPEGs; the promo hero alone is 852 KB and loads eagerly above the fold — several MB on first visit over mobile data
findings.fix: WebP/AVIF at 2 sizes (≤80 KB list thumbs, ≤150 KB hero), width/height attributes, fetchpriority on hero only

findings.description: Three Google Font families with ~13 weights/styles requested (Barlow Condensed ×7, Plus Jakarta ×4, JetBrains Mono ×2)
findings.fix: Trim to the weights actually used (≈5) or self-host subsets
